name: The Garden Reservoir
desc:
The Garden Reservoir is a location directly underneath the [Burning Stone Gardens](location:burning_stone_gardens). It seems to hold a resemblance and possibly be connected through unreachable tunnels to [The Viper's Jaw](location:the_vipers_jaw), possibly from underneath the acid. It is a gloomy area covered with pillars of stone, Irithine deposits and acid running along everywhere, possibly the main cause of acid in [Burning Stone Gardens](location:burning_stone_gardens). Going into the acid will end up with you taking damage and being put into combat.

There is a small cave within the Reservoir that contains multiple Soul Hearthgems, which are a necessary part of the Intelligence Unbound process.
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is In Shade, Hollow by Naktigonis.
-   The garden reservoir was once a large cave a part of [The Viper's Jaw](location:the_vipers_jaw) before collapsing into the [Burning Stone Gardens](location:burning_stone_gardens).
-   Players can find Irithine here, which is a metal used in crafting some Outfits.
-   Survivalist does not reduce or negate the damage taken by the Acid pools.
